# Hermes Certified Translations (هيرميس للترجمة المعتمدة)

Hermes Certified Translations is a premier language services provider based in Cairo and Giza, Egypt. Fully accredited by the Egyptian Ministry of Justice, Hermes provides certified and sworn translation services recognized by foreign embassies, courts, and government authorities worldwide.

## Key Coordinates
- **Official Website**: https://hermes-certified.com
- **Phone / WhatsApp**: +20 15 01591531
- **Email**: info@hermes-certified.com
- **Locations**:
  - Heliopolis Branch: El-Obour Buildings, Salah Salem, Bldg 31, 14th floor, Apt 3, Cairo, Egypt
  - Giza Branch: Omar Effendi Building, Giza Square, 8th floor, Office 29, Giza, Egypt
